fields.description: Golf Hillside is a 20-storey apartment tower in Dubai Hills Estate, facing the golf course and surrounding villa neighbourhoods. One to three bedroom homes sit above an amenity podium. The floor plans range from compact balcony apartments to lower-level homes with substantially larger outdoor areas.

overview: The residential layouts pair outdoor space with separate sleeping areas and open living rooms. Shared facilities include indoor and outdoor exercise spaces, a sports court and pools for adults and children. The brochure describes LED lighting, water-saving systems and sustainable materials. It also states a future intention to obtain LEED Gold and Al Safat certification; this is not evidence that either certification has already been awarded.
research.locationNote: The project overlooks the Dubai Hills golf-course and villa area, with Dubai Hills Mall and King’s College Hospital among nearby destinations. Al Khail Road provides wider road connections. Views depend on the chosen apartment; golf-club membership and future rail access are not included or guaranteed here.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s displayed-unit panel starts at AED 2,902,888 on the review date, while its headline retains the historic AED 1.47m launch price. The September 2024 fact sheet lists category starts of AED 1.47m, AED 2.73m and AED 3.65m for one, two and three bedrooms. Request a current unit-specific quotation.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule allocates eight payments of 10% before completion and 20% at completion. These dated launch terms do not establish the remaining instalments payable on a resale or later release.
research.handoverNote: The Emaar-branded payment document estimates December 2028 completion, also reported by Property Finder. This is an estimate, subject to the applicable contract and subsequent developer updates.

facts.label: Published residential mix
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 78 one-bedroom, 62 two-bedroom and 44 three-bedroom apartments, totalling 184 homes. These are development counts, not available inventory.

facts.label: Ground-floor outdoor space
facts.value: Three-bedroom G01 includes a study, separate toilet, powder room and laundry. Its printed total is 2,322.21 sq ft, including 824.08 sq ft recorded as balcony area and drawn as a wraparound terrace.

facts.label: Compare suite and balcony separately
facts.value: One-bedroom unit 106 totals 1,106.10 sq ft, including 403.86 sq ft outdoors. Typical B4 homes have a similar 702.24 sq ft suite but a 110.55 sq ft balcony. Larger total area need not mean proportionately larger interiors.

facts.label: Availability needs a fresh check
facts.value: Property Finder labels the project sold out while Emaar displays selected units. These channels may describe different stock; neither confirms that a particular home can currently be booked through Aliyas.
